narrative: The production Python implementation and an independently written MATLAB-transcribed Python port agree to numerical precision on real data (band levels, REOIG, PTPE) and on synthetic gain/SNR/THD signals. The MATLAB input file and the exact CSV contract are generated so that `matlab/run_cross_language_export.m` can be run on a machine with MATLAB; here that step is marked NOT RUN because MATLAB is unavailable. This distinction is deliberate: port agreement demonstrates algorithmic consistency, not execution of the MATLAB code.
